```{r}
propen_fit <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/guide_dataset/datafiles/propen.fit", header=TRUE)
data <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/guide_dataset/datafiles/ce2021miss.txt", header=TRUE)
```

```{r}
pie_hat <- propen_fit$predicted
w <- data$FINLWT21
Y <- data$INTRDVX
```

```{r}
s1 <- !is.na(Y)
```

```{r}
ipw_mean <- sum(w[s1]*Y[s1]/pie_hat[s1]) / sum(w[s1]/pie_hat[s1])
```

```{r}
ipw_mean
```
